description: This file defines a PHP class `ProjectViewGanttChart` that extends `ViewDetail` and is responsible for rendering a Gantt Chart view in the Project module of a SuiteCRM-based application. It includes methods for displaying the view, retrieving project data, linked resources, and rendering HTML/JavaScript for the Gantt chart interface and related popups.

classes.name: ProjectViewGanttChart
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail to render a Gantt chart view for projects, including data retrieval and interface rendering methods.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to generate the Gantt chart view, including resource fetching, date range calculations, and rendering HTML/JavaScript for the interface.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Calculates the duration between two dates in months and days, returning a formatted string.
